4 ازنأهُ فِى الجَبَلِ He made him to ascend the mountain. (Msb, K, * TA.) ―
-b2- ازنأهُ also signifies أَلْجَأَهُ: (S, K, TA:) so in the saying, ازنأهُ إِلَى الأَمْرِ [He constrained him to have recourse to, or to do, the thing]. (TA.) ―
-b3- ازنأ بَوْلَهُ He retained, or suppressed, his urine; (Msb, K; *) as also ↓ زَنَأَهُ ; the latter verb being trans. as well as intrans. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
